attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt mined until the address carries exactly the declared permission bits; the constructor validates its own bits so a mis-mined salt reverts the launch
attributes.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical dynamic-fee PoolKey. It binds exactly one pool once at afterInitialize, precommitting the exact launch token, start price and tick spacing so a front-runner cannot capture it with a foreign pool. It custodies one full-range position and mints self-priced share claims, draws a continuous Harberger tax from each claim's pre-paid deposit and rebates it to all LPs, lets anyone but the owner buy a claim out at its self-price, recycles a tax-exhausted claim to the remaining LPs, and collects the mandatory Programmable volume fee on the executed gross quote-side amount across all four swap quadrants as owner-claimable ERC-6909 quote claims held separately from the tax reserve.

attributes.callerRestriction: deployAndLaunch reverts unless msg.sender is the launch wallet fixed in the constructor, and reverts on any second call
attributes.residualBalance: every unspent unit of both currencies is returned to the launch wallet before the transaction ends
attributes.summary: Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool and seeds the initial full-range position through the hook's own custody deposit; the resulting Harberger claim is owned by the launcher, which exposes no withdraw, buyout, transfer, rescue, arbitrary-call, owner or upgrade path. Any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.

attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt chosen so the predicted address and the quote address sort into the canonical currency0/currency1 order for the PoolKey
attributes.summary: Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists.

attributes.ordering: after the token, so the mined hook salt commits the exact launched token, start price and tick spacing
first, so its address fixes the PoolKey currency ordering and the hook's precommitted token

attributes.failureRule: a foreign token, a mismatched start price or tick spacing, a non-quote pool or an over-budget seed reverts the whole launch
attributes.steps: PoolManager.initialize on the canonical dynamic-fee key, then afterInitialize binds the pool and records the pool key and full-range ticks, then the launcher approves and calls the hook's deposit to custody one full-range position and mint the seed Harberger claim to the launcher, then residual currency is returned to the launch wallet
